title: MemberList
description: Response of GET /v1/fleet/members (added in 3.1): the fleet members this core has heard announce themselves, built from announcements only. A member is listed only after an announcement arrives from a key in this core's trust list, and only under the node name the trust list gives that key; it is dropped after `silence_ms` without an announcement, or at once when it announces `leaving`. No address is reported. `heard_ms_ago` is measured on this core's monotonic clock: no timestamp from another host is read or compared. `refused` holds the announcements this core refused recently, the operator's report of a node name claimed by a key that does not hold it.

node.description: This core's own node name. This core is not an entry of `members`.

transport.description: `off` when the fleet transport is not configured: nothing is announced or heard, and both lists are empty.

announce_interval_ms.description: How often this core announces itself to the peers in its local address list.

silence_ms.description: How long a member may stay silent before it is dropped. It leaves the list within this time plus one sweep (1 s).

fingerprint.description: SHA-256 of a member's public key, lowercase hex. Public: it identifies the key, it gives no access.

member.description: One member heard from. `node` is the name this core's trust list gives the member's key, never a name taken from the announcement alone.

api_version.description: The control API version the member announced.

seq.description: The sequence number of the member's last announcement heard.

heard_ms_ago.description: Milliseconds since this core last heard the member, on this core's monotonic clock.

refusal.description: An announcement refused with `conflict`: the key `fingerprint`, which the trust list names `trusted_as`, claimed the node name `node`, which it does not hold or which another key holds. Repeats of the same claim by the same key are counted, not listed again.

announce_refusal.description: Body of the 409 reply to POST /v1/fleet/announce when the announcement is refused: the node name it claims is not the one the trust list gives the sender's key, is this core's own, or is held by another listed key. `error.json`'s `conflict` names a run, so the fleet transport has this shape of its own. `retryable` is true only when the name frees once its holder leaves or goes silent.

announcement.description: Body of POST /v1/fleet/announce, served over the fleet transport only (never on the control socket), and the body of its 200 reply, which is the answering core's own announcement. It carries no key material: who sent it is the key the transport authenticated.

state.description: `up` while the core runs; `leaving` once, on a clean stop, so that its peers drop it at once.
